input_freeze.static_match_method: read expected assignment AST with allowlisted literal dict/list/int/string/negative-int/list-repeat grammar; compare canonical JSON; do not import science_spec or call fixed-input loader
input_freeze.K_not_expanded: L1^2+L2^2 defined by fixed source; full Fock primary, N=2 identification, one exact bus; semantics in binding sidecar because executable input rejects extra keys

environment_freeze.portability_limit: exact runtime snapshot includes paths/platform; preserve current /tmp venv. Missing/moved/changed environment means stop, not silent replacement.

resource_freeze.basis: authorized practical resource policy, not wholesale adoption of prior R-TERMS-2; no scientific assumption added
resource_freeze.RLIMIT_AS_means: worker virtual address space, not total job RAM
resource_freeze.CPU_scope: one math worker pinned to one allowed CPU; separate supervisor/IO process; native parallel disabled
resource_freeze.wall_scope: supervise launch through worker output/end; controller preflight/final JSON and OS delay not strictly covered
resource_freeze.RSS_scope: sampled worker RSS, about 20ms; no guarantee against overshoot, supervisor RAM, external invocations

output_budget.scope: driver enforces managed capture/final envelope; bounded external writer and aggregate metadata budget are operator obligations, not a new driver guarantee
output_budget.on_full_or_failed_write: INCONCLUSIVE, stop, keep partial data/hash and consumed attempt; no retry

resource_freeze.trace_or_output_exhaustion_action: INCONCLUSIVE and mandatory STOP, no post-result rescue/retry
